mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_record ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, student_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, age INT, gender VARCHAR(16), class_name VARCHAR(64), email VARCHAR(128), birthday VARCHAR(32), UNIQUE KEY uk_student_record_student_no (student_no) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_import_stage ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, import_task_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, row_no INT NOT NULL, student_no VARCHAR(32), name VARCHAR(64), age INT, gender VARCHAR(16), class_name VARCHAR(64), email VARCHAR(128), birthday VARCHAR(32), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, KEY idx_student_import_stage_task_row (import_task_id, row_no), KEY idx_student_import_stage_task_student_no (import_task_id, student_no) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.statistics WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'student_record' AND index_name = 'uk_student_record_student_no'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT student_no FROM student_record GROUP BY student_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_student_no
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE student_record ADD UNIQUE KEY uk_student_record_student_no (student_no)
mapper.select: SELECT student_no, name, age, gender, class_name, email, birthday FROM student_record ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO student_record (student_no, name, age, gender, class_name, email, birthday) VALUES
(#{row.studentNo}, #{row.name}, #{row.age}, #{row.gender}, #{row.className}, #{row.email}, #{row.birthday})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), age = VALUES(age), gender = VALUES(gender), class_name = VALUES(class_name), email = VALUES(email), birthday = VALUES(birthday)

INSERT INTO student_import_stage (import_task_id, row_no, student_no, name, age, gender, class_name, email, birthday) VALUES
(#{row.importTaskId}, #{row.rowNo}, #{row.studentNo}, #{row.name}, #{row.age}, #{row.gender}, #{row.className}, #{row.email}, #{row.birthday})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_import_stage WHERE import_task_id = #{importTaskId} AND ( student_no IS NULL OR TRIM(student_no) = '' OR name IS NULL OR TRIM(name) = '' )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT student_no FROM student_import_stage WHERE import_task_id = #{importTaskId} AND student_no IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(student_no) <> '' GROUP BY student_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_record (student_no, name, age, gender, class_name, email, birthday) SELECT student_no, name, age, gender, class_name, email, birthday FROM student_import_stage WHERE import_task_id = #{importTaskId} ORDER BY row_no ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), age = VALUES(age), gender = VALUES(gender), class_name = VALUES(class_name), email = VALUES(email), birthday = VALUES(birthday)
